bodyEn: Your readings look okay right now. Rest when you can, drink water, and keep the band on. Ask again anytime you feel unsure.
bodySw: Vipimo vinaonekana sawa sasa. Pumzika unapoweza, kunywa maji, na uvae bendi. Uliza tena ukihisi wasiwasi.
source: WHO ANC danger-sign framing — calm when no danger signs (decision support)

bodyEn: Blood pressure can rise with stress or activity. Sit upright, rest quietly for a short while, then measure again. If it stays high, or you get headache, blurred vision, or upper belly pain, go to a clinic today.
bodySw: Shinikizo linaweza kupanda kwa msongo au shughuli. Kaa wima, pumzika kidogo, kisha pima tena. Likibaki juu, au ukipata kichwa, macho kufifia, au maumivu ya tumbo juu, nenda kliniki leo.
source: WHO hypertensive disorders / pre-eclampsia prevention & treatment (recheck + danger signs)

titleEn: Rest on your side and slow your breathing
bodyEn: If you feel dizzy, stressed, or tired while waiting, lie on your side (many midwives suggest the left), loosen tight clothes, and take slow breaths. This is comfort while you watch — it does not replace a clinic visit if danger signs appear.
bodySw: Ukihisi kizunguzungu, msongo, au uchovu unaposubiri, lala upande (wakunga wengi hushauri upande wa kushoto), fungua nguo ngumu, na pumua polepole. Hii ni faraja unapojichunguza — haibadilishi kwenda kliniki ikiwa dalili hatari zinaonekana.
source: WHO-aligned supportive care while monitoring; not a cure for hypertensive disease

titleEn: Warning signs with blood pressure — seek care today
titleSw: Dalili za onyo na shinikizo — tafuta huduma leo
bodyEn: Severe headache, blurred vision, or pain high in the belly with raised blood pressure are danger signs in pregnancy. Do not wait for morning. Contact your CHP and go to a health facility today. Neema does not diagnose pre-eclampsia; clinicians do.
bodySw: Kichwa kikali, macho kufifia, au maumivu ya juu ya tumbo pamoja na shinikizo lililoinuka ni dalili hatari. Usisubiri asubuhi. Wasiliana na CHP na nenda kituo cha afya leo. Neema haitoi utambuzi wa pre-eclampsia; wataalamu hufanya hivyo.
source: WHO pre-eclampsia / eclampsia recommendations — maternal danger signs

bodyEn: This is an emergency path. Go to the nearest health facility now. Open the SMS to your CHP so they know. Do not wait alone for readings to improve.
bodySw: Hii ni njia ya dharura. Nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu sasa. Fungua SMS kwa CHP wako wajue. Usisubiri peke yako vipimo viregee.
source: WHO emergency referral for maternal danger signs

bodyEn: Heavy bleeding in pregnancy or after birth is an emergency. Lie down if you feel faint, keep warm, and go to a facility now. Tell your CHP with the prepared message.
bodySw: Kutokwa damu nyingi wakati wa ujauzito au baada ya kujifungua ni dharura. Lala ukihisi kuzimia, jipate joto, na nenda kituo sasa. Mwambie CHP kwa ujumbe ulioandaliwa.

titleEn: Raised temperature — recheck and contact care
titleSw: Joto limeruka — pima tena na wasiliana
bodyEn: If you feel feverish or the band shows raised temperature, rest, drink fluids, and recheck. Contact a health worker today. After birth, fever with a fast pulse needs urgent care.
bodySw: Ukihisi homa au bendi inaonyesha joto limeruka, pumzika, kunywa maji, na pima tena. Wasiliana na mhudumu wa afya leo. Baada ya kujifungua, homa na mapigo ya haraka yanahitaji huduma ya haraka.

bodyEn: If baby’s movements have reduced, go to a clinic today. Do not wait to finish chores. Tell the midwife how the movements changed.
bodySw: Ikiwa msogeo wa mtoto umepungua, nenda kliniki leo. Usisubiri kumaliza kazi. Mwambie mkunga jinsi msogeo ulivyobadilika.
source: WHO ANC reduced fetal movement — seek assessment

bodyEn: Your heart is faster than your personal normal. Rest on your side, breathe slowly, and we will watch again. If you also have chest pain, fainting, heavy bleeding, or feel much worse, go to a facility.
bodySw: Moyo unapiga haraka kuliko kawaida yako. Pumzika upande, pumua polepole, na tutaangalia tena. Ukiwa na maumivu ya kifua, kuzimia, damu nyingi, au unajisikia vibaya zaidi, nenda kituo.
source: Neema personal baseline (escalate-only) + WHO supportive observation

titleEn: Check the band, then tell me how you feel
bodyEn: There is not enough clear data yet. Check the band fit and signal. You can still add blood pressure or symptoms. If you feel danger signs, go to care without waiting for the band.
bodySw: Bado hakuna data ya kutosha. Angalia bendi na ishara. Bado unaweza kuongeza shinikizo au dalili. Ukihisi dalili hatari, nenda huduma bila kusubiri bendi.

bodyEn: Antenatal visits catch problems early. Open your passport for the next visit date, bring your summary for the nurse, and ask them to write any new advice into your plan.
bodySw: Ziara za ujauzito hugundua matatizo mapema. Fungua pasipoti yako kwa tarehe ijayo, peleka muhtasari kwa muuguzi, na waandike ushauri mpya kwenye mpango wako.
source: WHO ANC contact schedule — continuity of care
